data.body:
[P2] Skip invocation retirement evidence when no work was launched

A missing fixture raises `NotImplementedError` before creating any invocation or control, but retirement still builds a nonempty snapshot with empty attempts and events. The coordinator treats that snapshot as owned work, rejects its empty inventory, and quarantines the persistent target, blocking remaining cases and subsequent runs. When no owned work was created or attempted, return quiescent without populating `context.retirement_evidence`. Add a coordinator regression with a missing fixture followed by a supported case on the same target.
